blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of former President Rodrigo Duterte opposed the prosecution’s request before the International Criminal Court to allow many of its witnesses to testify in a fully closed session. In an 11-page submission made public on Monday (Tuesday Manila time), Duterte’s counsel Peter Haynes noted that prosecutors asked “a third of its witnesses” to […]...
